data.body:
Root cause: _tracker_sync_status folded TimeoutExpired into a private rc-124 CompletedProcess and read every non-zero rc as an ancestry answer. Reproduced with 2 regression tests (merge-base timeout -> 'shares no history' DIVERGED; --is-ancestor timeout -> 'share history (0 local-only, 0 remote-only)' DIVERGED). Fix: run_git_bounded + git_outcome.is_watchdog_timeout; a timeout raises out of the classifier and is reported as an uncounted WARN naming the git operation and the 120s bound.

AC4 audit of the other private rc-124 folds:
- fsck_repair._git_push: timeout is not non-fast-forward, so the batch aborts with 'ABORT: push failed ... timed out after 30s'. Honest; no verdict misread.
- _init_probe.run_bounded_git: a timed-out ls-remote is classified UNREACHABLE, documented fail-closed. Correct.
- _snapshot/ticket_receipt._run_git: raises PinnedTicketViewError naming the timeout; no fold.
- _snapshot/git_fetch.git_run: timeout-as-verdict shape (rev-parse -> 'cannot resolve ref', git remote -> 'no remote'). Filed as educatory-toxic-eel (discovered_from).
